Project Scientist-I / Principal Project Associate / Senior Project Associate

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CMERI Eligibility and Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility is post-code-specific. Candidates must match the exact discipline, qualification and experience prescribed for the selected post code. Candidate caution: The general patterns above do not replace the post-code-wise qualification table in the official notification. Applicants should verify their exact branch and experience before attending.

rows.general_qualification_pattern: B.Sc. or three-year Diploma in a relevant Engineering or Technology discipline.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering/Technology or Master’s/Integrated Master’s in the discipline specified for the post code.
Relevant Bachelor’s degree with two years of R&D experience, or a relevant Master’s/Integrated Master’s degree.
Relevant Graduate/Postgraduate Engineering or Technology degree with NET, GATE or another prescribed national-level selection route.
Relevant Graduate/Postgraduate qualification through the prescribed national-level selection route and two years of research experience.
Relevant Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with the experience prescribed for the post code.
Relevant Bachelor’s degree with six years of experience, or Master’s/Integrated Master’s/Doctoral qualification with the prescribed experience.
Relevant Master’s/Integrated Master’s degree with four years of R&D experience.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CMERI Age Limit and Relaxation
content_sections.text: The upper age limit varies from 28 to 50 years , depending on the post code. The relevant interview date will be used to determine age, qualification and experience. SC, ST, PwBD and women candidates receive up to five years of age relaxation. OBC candidates receive up to three years of age relaxation, subject to applicable Government of India and CSIR rules.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CMERI Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The notified consolidated remuneration ranges from ₹20,000 to ₹56,000 per month . HRA is payable only where specifically mentioned. For certain Project Associate posts, the higher remuneration applies to candidates who have qualified NET, GATE or another prescribed national-level examination. Project Assistant-II: ₹20,000 per month, with HRA for specified post codes. Project Associate-I: generally ₹25,000 or ₹31,000, depending on eligibility conditions. Project Associate-II: generally ₹28,000 or ₹35,000. Project JRF: ₹37,000. Senior Project Associate: ₹42,000. Principal Project Associate: ₹49,000. Project Scientist-I: ₹56,000, with the notified experience-based increment condition.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CMERI Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the candidate’s performance and overall assessment by the selection committee during the walk-in process. The institute may publish results on its website or communicate them by email. Document and eligibility verification Walk-in interview Performance and overall assessment by the selection committee Final engagement subject to availability of funds and approval of the competent authority

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for the Walk-in Interview
content_sections.text: Completed prescribed application form All original educational certificates and mark sheets One self-attested photocopy of each document Recent passport-size photograph Experience certificates, where required Category or PwBD certificate, where applicable NET, GATE or other qualifying-examination proof, where applicable NOC from the competent authority for candidates presently engaged in a CSIR project

content_sections.heading: How to Attend the CSIR-CMERI Walk-in Interview
content_sections.text: No TA/DA: Candidates will not receive travel or daily allowance for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CMERI Recruitment 2026 Important Links
content_sections.text: Download Official Notification Visit Official Website

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: The actual number of positions may vary on the interview date. Project tenure is tentative and may be reduced or extended. Engagement is co-terminus with the project or requirement, whichever ends earlier. Candidates who have already completed six years of project engagement in CSIR laboratories are not eligible. The English version of the notification will prevail in case of a discrepancy. Offer letters are subject to fund availability and approval of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q1. How many positions are listed in CSIR-CMERI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification lists 34 positions across 29 post codes. This figure is calculated from the position-wise table, and the actual number may vary on the interview date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the walk-in interview dates?
faq.answer: The interviews are scheduled for 13 and 14 August 2026. The applicable date depends on the candidate's post code.

faq.question: Q3. What is the reporting time?
faq.answer: Candidates should report between 9:30 AM and 11:30 AM at the CSIR-CMERI venue in Durgapur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary range?
faq.answer: The notified consolidated remuneration ranges from ₹20,000 to ₹56,000 per month. HRA is available for specified post codes.

faq.question: Q5. Is NET or GATE compulsory for all posts?
faq.answer: No. NET, GATE or another national-level examination is mandatory or salary-relevant only for specified post codes. Candidates should verify the exact condition for their chosen post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is the engagement permanent?
faq.answer: No. All advertised positions are temporary, project-based and co-terminus with the applicable project or requirement.

faq.question: Q8. Will TA or DA be paid?
faq.answer: No TA or DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. Do existing CSIR project employees need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates currently engaged in a project at CSIR-CMERI or another CSIR laboratory must produce an NOC from the competent authority.

faq.question: Q10. Can the selection process continue to the next day?
faq.answer: Yes. The notification advises candidates that the selection process may continue until late evening or the following day.
